For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.

-- Final result
WITH daily_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as daily_net_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
running_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, daily_net_change,
           SUM(daily_net_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_balance
    FROM daily_net
),
all_first_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(txn_date)) as first_month
    FROM daily_net
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_day AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as first_txn_date
    FROM daily_net
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT rb.customer_id, rb.txn_date, rb.running_balance,
           AVG(rb2.running_balance) as rolling_30d_avg
    FROM running_balance rb
    JOIN running_balance rb2 
        ON rb.customer_id = rb2.customer_id 
        AND rb2.txn_date >= rb.txn_date - INTERVAL '29' DAY
        AND rb2.txn_date <= rb.txn_date
    GROUP BY rb.customer_id, rb.txn_date, rb.running_balance
),
with_first_day AS (
    SELECT ra.customer_id, ra.txn_date, ra.rolling_30d_avg,
           fd.first_txn_date,
           DATEDIFF('day', fd.first_txn_date, ra.txn_date) as days_since_first
    FROM rolling_avg ra
    JOIN first_day fd ON ra.customer_id = fd.customer_id
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
           GREATEST(0, rolling_30d_avg) as rolling_30d_avg_capped
    FROM with_first_day
    WHERE days_since_first >= 29
),
with_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, rolling_30d_avg_capped,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date) as month_date
    FROM qualified
),
excluded AS (
    SELECT wm.customer_id, wm.txn_date, wm.rolling_30d_avg_capped, wm.month_date
    FROM with_month wm
    JOIN all_first_month afm ON wm.customer_id = afm.customer_id
    WHERE wm.month_date != afm.first_month
),
max_per_customer_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_date,
           MAX(rolling_30d_avg_capped) as max_30d_avg
    FROM excluded
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_date
)
SELECT month_date, SUM(max_30d_avg) as total_max_30d_avg
FROM max_per_customer_month
GROUP BY month_date
ORDER BY month_date
